Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the specific award details from the official Tony Awards page it loaded. In Step 4, the agent navigated to the correct URL (`https://www.tonyawards.com/history/year-by-year/1954/`) which contains the answer (Audrey Hepburn won for Leading Actress in a Play), but instead of reading and extracting the text from that page, it immediately initiated a new search query. This failure to utilize the primary source it had already accessed prevented the conversation from concluding with the correct, verified answer, leading to an endless loop of searching rather than solving the problem.
